gen-press-start-2p-fs-hind: Playful and retro, Press Start 2P spaces its pixel letters far apart like cut-outs pinned to a board. And Hind follows with lowercase close to its capitals in height, a sans that would carry a long passage in one steady line.
gen-gf-autour-one-satoshi: Satoshi reads open and friendly, with a soaring x-height and an e that never squeezes shut, all in one stroke width. Autour One brings the bold flourish that makes it stand out.
gen-gf-oxanium-manrope: Manrope keeps every curved letter bright at the mouth, drawn with a pen line that holds one width throughout. But Oxanium is the one that makes lowercase look big, its monoline curves ending in clear daylight.
gen-gf-metamorphous-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Distinctive, regal letters with generous sidebearings and a soft brush-like shift in stroke. Pilcrow Rounded sits beside them with tight spacing and parallel-edged curves, so the two feel like a ceremony next to a friendly chat.
gen-righteous-fs-alpino: Alpino stands tall and cozy, its spacing tight and its curve endings held well apart, so ascenders look short. Righteous, a thread of ink with bowls filling the line, would swamp it if made small.
gen-righteous-fs-hind: Righteous bends thin steel rod into bowls that fill the line, and it earns its keep big and short. Hind then supplies a plain sans body, with steady strokes like a drawn string.
gen-gf-funnel-display-fs-nunito: Expressive from the first line, Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like strokes whose c tips never creep toward touching. Nunito rounds it out with big round bowls and terminals finishing clear of the stem, which is the pair's friendliest quality.
gen-gf-revalia-fs-pilcrow-rounded: A lowercase g with an open lower curve gives Revalia its odd charm, spread in a relaxed stride. Pilcrow Rounded answers with tight spacing and curves that refuse to close, so the two feel loose against snug.
gen-silkscreen-fs-amulya: Silkscreen scatters lo-fi letters with space you can almost feel, each line like spaghetti laid out. Amulya keeps its curve gaps generous in a plain sans, and that modern openness is the pair's best quality.
gen-silkscreen-fs-chillax: Space you can almost feel surrounds every Silkscreen letter, giving it a lo-fi, retro hush. But Chillax loosens things with pen-lifted curves that leave loops unfinished, and that relaxed looseness is what the pair does best.
